blocks.text: Your app crashed in production? Deployment stuck? Native side acting weird?
We come in and save the day.
€250/hour effective rate • Additional hours available at the same rate
When Things Go Wrong With Mobile Apps
Your app starts crashing for thousands of users. The stack trace points to native code you don't understand.
Apple or Google rejected your update. The error message is cryptic. Your deadline is tomorrow.
Something broke after the last update. Your web team doesn't know native. Days of debugging ahead.
With Premium Support, you have Capacitor experts ready to jump in when you need help.
When your app crashes in production or deployment fails, we drop everything to help you fix it fast.
Deep knowledge of iOS, Android, and Capacitor internals. We solve the problems your team can't.
Stop spending days debugging native issues. Get expert help and ship your features faster.
Talk directly to our engineers. No ticket queues, no waiting for triage. Real experts, real fast.
Any Capacitor or mobile app problem your team is struggling with.
App store rejections, build failures, signing problems
Production crashes, memory issues, ANRs on Android
iOS/Android native code bugs, plugin conflicts
Capacitor plugin configuration, custom plugin debugging
App optimization, startup time, memory usage
Capgo integration, update failures, rollback issues
Sign up for €1,000/month. You get 4 hours of expert support ready to use.
When you hit a problem, contact us via email or Discord. Describe the issue.
Our experts jump in, diagnose the problem, and help you solve it fast.
Peace of mind for your Capacitor app
What if I need more than 4 hours?
Additional hours are billed at €250/hour. Most companies find 4 hours sufficient for a typical month, but some months you might need more help, and that's totally fine.
No, hours don't roll over to the next month. The retainer ensures we're available and prioritize your requests when you need help. Think of it as insurance for your app.
We aim to respond within hours during business days. For critical production issues, we prioritize getting you help as fast as possible.
What's the difference from regular support?
Regular support is for Capgo product questions. Premium Support is for any Capacitor app problem - deployment issues, crashes, native bugs, performance - anything your team needs expert help with.
Do I need to be a Capgo customer?
No! Premium Support is available to any company with a Capacitor app, whether you use Capgo or not.
Have Capacitor experts on standby. When something breaks, we fix it fast.
